k:理.mnemonic: A king (王) walks his hometown (里) and explains the reason for every rule. Reason (logic, principle).

k:成.mnemonic: A halberd (戈) with a slide (ノ) hooked onto it. Add the right piece to a halberd and it becomes a proper weapon. Become (achieve).

k:村.mnemonic: A tree (木) and a measurement (寸). Measure out the land from the big tree and build the village. Village.

k:重.mnemonic: A thousand (千) hometowns (里) piled on your back. Heavy.
k:重.hint: A thousand hometowns on your back.

k:動.mnemonic: Power (力) applied to something heavy (重). Push hard enough and it moves. Move.

k:弓.mnemonic: A bow seen from the side, curved and strung. Bow.

k:竹.mnemonic: Two stalks of bamboo side by side, leaves drooping at the top. Bamboo.

k:思.mnemonic: A rice field (田) on top of a heart (心). In old drawings the field shape was the brain: brain plus heart is thinking. Think.

k:第.mnemonic: Bamboo (竹) tallies over a bow (弓) with a stroke through it. The bamboo tallies are counted off in order: first, second, third. Ordinal (number).

k:羊.mnemonic: A sheep's face from the front: two horns on top, then the face and the line down the nose. Sheep.

k:書.mnemonic: A brush (聿) above a sun (日): a brush writing on a bright page. Write.

k:業.mnemonic: A sheep (羊) sitting on a book (本). Every business keeps its books, and this one raises sheep. Business (industry).

k:不.mnemonic: A bird flying up into the sky and hitting a line: it cannot get through. Not.
k:不.hint: A bird blocked by a line.

k:貝.mnemonic: A shell with two little feet poking out of the bottom. Shells were the first money. Shellfish.

k:員.mnemonic: A mouth (口) over a shellfish (貝). Everyone with a mouth to feed and shells to spend is a member of staff. Member.
k:員.hint: Mouth to feed, shells to spend.

k:元.mnemonic: Two lines on top of legs (儿): a head on a body, the origin of a person. Origin (former).

k:何.mnemonic: A leader (亻) asks: can (可) we? What? What.

k:氏.mnemonic: A figure holding a clan flag with a spike at the bottom. Clan (Mr., family name).
k:氏.hint: A clan flag on a spike.

k:民.mnemonic: A mouth (口) with a clan (氏) beneath it. All the mouths in the clan are the people. People (nation).

k:白.mnemonic: The sun (日) with a ray sticking up: light so bright it is white. White.

k:的.mnemonic: A white (白) circle inside a cradle (勹): a white bullseye held up as a target. Target (-like).

k:記.mnemonic: Say (言) something to a cobra (已) and it will write down every word. Write down (record).
k:記.hint: The cobra writes down what you say.

k:平.mnemonic: Horns (丷) on a dry (干) rack, pressed down flat. Flat (even, peace).

k:風.mnemonic: A hood (几-like sail) with an insect being blown around inside it. Wind.

k:連.mnemonic: A car (車) on the path (辶) with a line of people following. Take along (connect).
k:連.hint: Car towing a line along the path.

k:千.mnemonic: A slide (ノ) on top of a ten (十). Ten with a flourish on top is a thousand.
